answer_1.quote: We examine whether the dataset STORYANALOGY can enhance the ability of analogy generation. We evaluate FlanT5, LLaMa, ChatGPT (OpenAI, 2022), and GPT-3.5 in zero-shot and few-shot settings using 40 source stories from the test set.
answer_1.outputs: Generated analogical stories (target stories) for given source stories

answer_4.quote: We conduct crowd annotation on AMT to evaluate the generation quality. Workers are provided with a source story and its corresponding generated target story. They are then asked to assess the following: (1) Whether the target story is an analogy for the source story. (2) Novelty of the target story; (3) Plausibility of the generations.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judge each generated story on three criteria: analogy to the source, novelty compared to the source, and overall plausibility.
